title: Custom Soccer Ball with Lightning Splash Comforter Set - A11
description:
Inspire young soccer enthusiasts with this Jeminise Soccer Player Comforter Set, perfect for adding a sporty touch to any boy's room. This custom bedding set allows for personalization with a name and number, making it a thoughtful gift for any soccer fan.

Key Features

  • Soccer Enthusiasm: Designed to fuel children's excitement for soccer, inspiring them to chase their dreams.
  • Personalized Design: Customize this comforter set with a name and number for a unique touch.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Easy to Use: Features a hidden zipper and smooth metal pull for effortless duvet insertion and removal.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Utilizes environmental protection techniques to prevent fading and ensure lasting dye vibrancy with smooth, fine, and compact stitching.
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water and dries quickly without heat, maintaining its fluffy texture.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polycotton
Fabric Type Polycotton
Pattern Soccer
Selected Design A4
Included Components Duvet Cover
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Selected Size Full
Customization 1 text input
Pillowcase Length 20 inches
Pillowcase Quantity 2
Pillowcase Width 20 inches
Sham Quantity 2
Style Name Modern
Thread Count 360
Care Instructions Machine Wash
